crossRefs.note: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.
Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and…
He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to…
Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.
and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was…

translations.web: When they heard that he was alive, and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.
translations.bsb: And when they heard that Jesus was alive and she had seen Him, they did not believe it.
translations.kjv: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
translations.asv: And they, when they heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, disbelieved.
